description: This file defines the EfRepository class which implements a generic repository pattern using Entity Framework Core for data access in the eShopOnWeb project. It extends RepositoryBase and implements interfaces IReadRepository and IRepository, providing a data repository for aggregate root entities.

classes.name: EfRepository
classes.description: A generic repository implementation using Entity Framework Core that supports read and write operations for aggregate root entities.

methods.name: EfRepository
methods.description: Constructor that initializes EfRepository with a given CatalogContext database context.
